payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_sigterm.py::test_a_cell_sent_sigterm_tears_down_and_closes_its_task stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The handler is installed and never put back, so the disposition after `main` is still its own.' applied to saffron/cli.py as an edit. The claim was "`saffron cell` sent a real SIGTERM mid-IMPLEMENT, and again mid-REVIEW, exits 143. Its run reads `ABORTED`, its task reads `ORPHANED`, and its patch is exported to the task directory. No agent turn starts after the signal. The teardown that follows removes the critic cell's container and two volumes when REVIEW was running. It then removes the cell's own container, both its networks and both its volumes, and stops the proxy. After `main` returns, the SIGTERM handler is the one `main` found, and that handler heard nothing. A `KeyboardInterrupt` with no SIGTERM behind it still propagates out of `main`.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
